countries.primary_firing_sources: SEBI Reg 30; EPFO ECR; MCA MGT-7/AOC-4; Listed IT/Tech Disclosures
countries.primary_hiring_sources: EPFO Payroll (Fresh UAN vs Re-joined); ESIC; MoSPI PLFS; SEBI IT Disclosures; CRE Leases
countries.verified_2yr_observations: TCS FY26 net headcount fell by 23,460 to 584,519 (mix of restructuring, attrition & tighter bench rules); Indian startup layoffs estimated ~9,500 in 2025 (Inc42); Oracle & Qualcomm 2026 India cuts reported as unconfirmed/estimated ranges
countries.hidden_internal_gap: Industrial Relations Code, 2020 (300-worker approval threshold; >Rs. 18,000/mo supervisory exclusion) drives silent PIPs/resignations; Sept 17, 2026 EPFO wage-ceiling jump (Rs. 15k to Rs. 25k) creates a regime break; off-roll staffing vendors obscure GCC cuts
countries.practical_verdict: Macro formal payroll trends are observable via EPFO/ESIC/PLFS with regime-break adjustments; company-level silent layoffs and GCC vendor off-boarding often remain internal or estimated.

countries.primary_firing_sources: SEC Form 8-K (Item 2.05) & 10-K; State WARN Logs (CA, TX, WA, NY, NJ, IL); BLS JOLTS Layoffs
countries.primary_hiring_sources: BLS JOLTS Actual Hires; BLS CES Nonfarm Payrolls (+885k YoY Oct 2025-Oct 2026); US DOL OFLC LCA/PERM; Direct ATS
countries.verified_2yr_observations: BLS nonfarm payrolls rose +885,000 over 12 months ending Oct 2026 (private +943,000; Information -119,000, Financial Activities -99,000); major 2026 corporate restructurings & VEPs (e.g., Microsoft VEP up to 60,000 eligible; separate from actual departures)
countries.hidden_internal_gap: Remote workers across states, sub-threshold site cuts (<50 or <33%), state mini-WARN rules (NY 90-day/25+ vs CA 50+ no 33% rule), and 'ghost jobs' inflating advertised openings above realized hires
countries.practical_verdict: High statutory observability via SEC 8-K Item 2.05, WARN, and BLS JOLTS/CES; requires strict separation of VEP eligibility, remote/mini-WARN rules, and ghost postings.

countries.primary_firing_sources: UK Insolvency Service / HR1 Notifications; SEC 8-K/6-K (US-listed firms); Corporate Filings & Investor Decks
countries.primary_hiring_sources: ONS PAYE Real Time Information (RTI) Payroll; ONS Vacancies; Direct ATS & Financial Disclosures
countries.verified_2yr_observations: Structured UK restructuring and cross-border MNC cuts (e.g., Flutter UK/Ireland restructuring plans up to 1,400 roles at risk alongside European hubs) tracked against ONS payroll and vacancy series
countries.hidden_internal_gap: HR1 triggers at 20+ proposed redundancies at one establishment; settlement agreements/voluntary exits and internal role shifts are not separately itemized in public aggregate tables
countries.practical_verdict: Strong macro payroll and vacancy series via ONS; company-specific figures require cross-checking corporate disclosures, HR1 filings, and settlement nuances.

countries.primary_firing_sources: Eurofound ERM; Federal Employment Agency (BA) Mass Dismissal Notices; Corporate Restructuring & Works Council Disclosures
countries.primary_hiring_sources: Eurostat Job Vacancy Statistics (JVS); Destatis & BA Employment Series; Direct Corporate Disclosures
countries.verified_2yr_observations: Industrial and automotive restructuring headlines (including large multi-year targets such as Volkswagen's reported restructuring plans) alongside Eurofound ERM and BA reporting
countries.hidden_internal_gap: Works council negotiations, phased multi-year social plans (Sozialplan), and short-time work/transfer companies stretch execution across years, while media headlines often merge multi-year targets into single-year numbers
countries.practical_verdict: Good institutional and macro tracking, but multi-year phased execution and headline aggregation require separating announced multi-year plans from actual annual exits.

countries.primary_firing_sources: Singapore Ministry of Manpower (MOM) Retrenchment Reports; Corporate Filings & Regional APAC Disclosures
countries.primary_hiring_sources: MOM Labour Market & Employment Change Statistics; Employment Pass / Job Vacancies Series
countries.verified_2yr_observations: MOM publishes quarterly retrenchment aggregates across sectors while MNC regional hub cuts are frequently announced globally without country-level breakdowns
countries.hidden_internal_gap: MOM reports aggregate retrenchment counts rather than full firm-by-firm public lists for smaller cuts; APAC regional hub reductions often remain bundled inside global MNC announcements
countries.practical_verdict: Reliable aggregate quarterly statistics from MOM; firm-level APAC hub cuts require parent-child linking to avoid double-counting global announcements.

countries.primary_firing_sources: Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) Timely Disclosures; Corporate Early Retirement / Restructuring Announcements; MHLW Surveys
countries.primary_hiring_sources: MHLW Labour Force Survey & Job Openings-to-Applicants Ratio; Corporate Recruiting & Campus Disclosures
countries.verified_2yr_observations: Lower headline layoff volatility due to labor protections; workforce adjustments often occur via voluntary early retirement programs (kibo taishoku), internal transfers, or hiring moderation
countries.hidden_internal_gap: Voluntary early retirement programs and internal reassignments are distinct from involuntary layoffs and can be misread if not tagged as voluntary_buyout_offer or net_headcount_change
countries.practical_verdict: High corporate disclosure discipline on TSE for material restructurings; requires strict event-type separation between voluntary retirement offers and forced cuts.

countries.primary_firing_sources: Provincial Group Termination Notices (e.g., Ontario Ministry of Labour); SEC Filings (Cross-listed firms); Corporate Releases
countries.primary_hiring_sources: Statistics Canada Labour Force Survey & Job Vacancy and Wage Survey (JVWS); Direct ATS
countries.verified_2yr_observations: Provincial group termination disclosures and cross-listed corporate updates complement Statistics Canada payroll/vacancy releases, while global tech/MNC cuts affect Canadian hubs
countries.hidden_internal_gap: Group termination thresholds vary by province (typically 50+ employees at a single establishment over 4 weeks), leaving smaller or dispersed cuts outside statutory group lists
countries.practical_verdict: Solid macro statistics from Statistics Canada and provincial termination notices for larger site cuts; dispersed and small cuts require corporate-level verification.

countries.primary_firing_sources: Australian Securities Exchange (ASX) Market Announcements; Corporate Restructuring Disclosures; Fair Work / Media Corroboration
countries.primary_hiring_sources: Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) Labour Force & Job Vacancies; Direct ATS & Corporate Filings
countries.verified_2yr_observations: ASX-listed company restructurings and local branches of global firms tracked alongside ABS employment and job vacancy releases
countries.hidden_internal_gap: No single centralized national layoff registry for all private redundancies; smaller internal restructurings may not meet ASX materiality thresholds
countries.practical_verdict: Clear macro ABS series and ASX disclosures for material listed-company events; granular private-firm cuts have uneven public visibility.

countries.primary_firing_sources: Eurofound ERM; PSE (Plan de Sauvegarde de l'Emploi) / Ministry of Labour Filings; Corporate Disclosures
countries.primary_hiring_sources: INSEE Employment & Payroll Series; DARES / France Travail Job Market Indicators; Eurostat JVS
countries.verified_2yr_observations: Large collective redundancies in France (such as industrial and automotive restructuring plans reported in late 2026) involve formal consultation processes and Eurofound/public reporting
countries.hidden_internal_gap: Formal consultation/PSE timelines span months and can be revised downward before execution; early media figures often reflect initial proposals rather than finalized departures
countries.practical_verdict: Formal collective-redundancy processes create structured documentation, but proposals frequently evolve—requiring range logging and announcement vs. effective dates.

countries.primary_firing_sources: Novo CAGED (Formal Ministry of Labour Admissions/Dismissals); Corporate & Securities Disclosures
countries.primary_hiring_sources: Novo CAGED Net Formal Employment; IBGE PNAD Continua Household Survey; Direct ATS
countries.verified_2yr_observations: Novo CAGED captures formal admissions and dismissals monthly across registered firms, while corporate-level tech/LATAM cuts are often reported only as broad regional ranges
countries.hidden_internal_gap: Informal work and contractor arrangements sit outside formal CAGED payroll records, and regional LATAM layoff estimates are frequently bundled or approximated in media reports
countries.practical_verdict: Novo CAGED gives strong monthly formal-sector turnover signals at the macro/sector level, but company-specific cuts outside formal filings remain partially opaque.
